name: FIEZEL PTE Academic Universal Templates
description: Standardized pedagogical templates designed for guaranteed scoring in Pearson AI automated grading algorithms.

describe_image.title: FIEZEL Universal Describe Image Template
describe_image.text: The given image represents an informative chart regarding [Topic]. According to the picture, we can see several key elements, including [Element 1], [Element 2], and [Element 3]. Looking closely, the maximum figure is observed in [Key Trend / High Point], while the minimum figure is found in [Low Point]. In conclusion, the picture provides significant data and is very beneficial for further understanding.

fill_guide.Topic: Title or main subject of the chart/diagram
fill_guide.Key Trend / High Point: The highest bar, peak year, or dominant section
fill_guide.Low Point: The lowest bar, valley, or smallest portion

tips: Do not stop speaking before 25 seconds; Pearson rewards oral fluency and continuous acoustic flow over complex logic.
Pronounce the template with natural sentence stress and steady rhythm (120-140 words per minute).
If you stumble on a number, do not correct yourself—keep moving smoothly to the next sentence.

retell_lecture.title: FIEZEL Retell Lecture Standard Scaffold
retell_lecture.text: The speaker was discussing the primary aspects of [Main Topic]. Firstly, the speaker highlighted that [Key Note 1]. In addition, significant emphasis was placed on [Key Note 2]. Furthermore, the presentation provided crucial evidence about [Key Note 3]. Overall, the lecture provided highly comprehensive insights into the subject matter.
tips: Take 4-6 noun chunks during the audio playback.
Insert the noun chunks directly into the template slots without worrying about complex grammar transformation.

summarize_written_text.title: FIEZEL Strict One-Sentence Summarizer Scaffold
summarize_written_text.rules: Strict single sentence (5-75 words), one capital letter at beginning, exactly one period at end.
summarize_written_text.formula: [Key Sentence 1], and [Key Sentence 2], which demonstrates that [Author Conclusion].
tips: Never use more than one period in the entire response.
Keep word count strictly between 35 and 65 words for maximum content and grammar safety.

To begin with, the foremost justification is that [Argument 1]. Specifically, [Supporting Evidence 1]. For example, empirical studies conducted in recent years have demonstrated that [Concrete Example 1]. Consequently, it is evident that [Concluding thought 1].

Furthermore, another pivotal factor that should be considered is that [Argument 2]. In other words, [Supporting Evidence 2]. To illustrate, modern organizations and academic institutions frequently observe that [Concrete Example 2]. Hence, this clearly reinforces the significance of the issue.

In conclusion, after evaluating the aforementioned perspectives, I reiterate that although alternative viewpoints exist, [Rephrased Thesis]. Therefore, taking proactive measures regarding this matter will undoubtedly yield long-term advantages.
